title: Graduated Cylinders

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)

purpose: Narrow cylindrical vessels marked with volume graduations, used for measuring liquid volumes more precisely than a beaker but less precisely than a volumetric flask.
safety: Read the meniscus at eye level for the most accurate volume reading.
Choose a cylinder sized close to the volume being measured — using a much larger cylinder for a small volume reduces reading precision.
